title: Introduction to Python, in two lessons
description: Printing a program result and swapping list items with bundled Python.
author: OpenCourse
subject: Programming

blocks.content:
# Python lists

A list holds values. Use indices to read or change its items. Two names can refer to the same list. Python exercises run in a local course virtual environment.

## Key takeaways

- Python is bundled with OpenCourse.
- A list is mutable.
- Assignment can swap two items.

blocks.question: What index selects the first list item?
blocks.explanation: Python list indices start at zero.

blocks.title: Swap the first two items
blocks.prompt: Implement swap(items) to exchange the first two list items in place.
blocks.solution:
def swap(items):
    items[0], items[1] = items[1], items[0]
